ratio_box.verdict: Does the amount reach the assessee first as his own income and then applied? If yes, it is an Application of Income. A self-imposed obligation by the recipient does NOT create an overriding title.

title.text: Exam Takeaways: Diversion Doctrine

rules.exp: Overriding title exists only if an external superior law, court decree, or payer creates the obligation before income reaches the assessee.
Diversion occurs at the source (interception). Applying funds after earning title or receipt is mere destination (application).
A professional directing clients to pay fees into their own trust is fully taxable under Section 28 as PGBP; Chapter VI-A (Section 80G) can only be explored separately.

beats.voice_sync_text: Students, namukku Question 30-le double property scenario crystal clear aayi analyze cheyyaam. Assessee Mr. Rajesh-inu randu properties aanu ullathu. First property, Bangalore-il ulla let out residential house. Ithu tenant Mr. Kumar-inu vadakakku koduthu, annual rent 3 Lakhs receive cheyyunnu. title.text: Computation of Income from Bangalore House Property

beats.voice_sync_text: Aadyamaayi namukku Bangalore let-out house property-ude net income compute cheyyaam. Gross Annual Value, actual rent aaya 3 Lakh rupees edukkaam. Section 23 prakaaram, assessee actually paid cheytha municipal taxes current plus arrears serthu 1 Lakh 85 Thousand rupees subtract cheyyuka. Appol Net Annual Value 1 Lakh 15 Thousand rupees aayi maari. Section 24(a) standard deduction 30 percent subtract cheythaal 34 Thousand 500 rupees. Next, property major repair-nu edutha loan interest Section 24(b) prakaaram full 1 Lakh 50 Thousand rupees deduct cheyyaam. Pinne, Section 25A prakaaram receive cheytha rent arrears 30 Thousand rupees-il ninnu 30 percent deduction kazhinju taxable 21 Thousand add cheythaal, Net Loss from House Property 48 Thousand 500 rupees aayi maari.

title.text: Chennai House Transfer & Section 50C Stamp Duty Benchmark

beats.voice_sync_text: Next, Chennai property transfer-il Capital Gains compute cheyyaam. Evide crucial statutory provision Section 50C aanu. Actual sale consideration 25 Lakh rupees aanu. Ithinte 110 percent safe harbor threshold 27 Lakh 50 Thousand rupees aanu. Ennaal registration authority-ude Stamp Duty Value 30 Lakh rupees aayi nischayichirikkunnu. Stamp Duty Value safe harbor limit-inekaal higher aaya kaaranathaal, Section 50C trigger aavukayum, deemed Full Value of Consideration 30 Lakh rupees aayi enforce cheyyukayum cheyyunnu. Gift aayathinaal Section 49(1) prakaaram father-nte cost of acquisition aaya 1 Lakh 25 Thousand rupees subtract cheythaal, Gross Long Term Capital Gain 28 Lakh 75 Thousand rupees varunnu.

title.text: Section 54 Relief: Two Adjacent Flats Combined as Single Unit

beats.voice_sync_text: Rajesh ee sale proceeds upayogichu reinvestment cheyyukayaanu. Section 54 exemption claim cheyyaan Bangalore-il randu adjacent flats, Flat 101 8 Lakhs-inum Flat 102 7 Lakhs-inum purchase cheythu. Randu separate sale deeds aanenkilum, internal wall remove cheythu oru single habitable residential unit aayi modify cheythu. Karnataka High Court-inte landmark CIT versus Ananda Basappa ruling prakaaram, adjacent flats combine cheythu single residential unit aakkiyaal Section 54-le 'a residential house' condition fully satisfy aakum. Athinaal total investment aaya 15 Lakh rupees-um Section 54 exemption aayi allow cheyyappedum.

title.text: Section 54EC Bond Subscription: Date of Payment Benchmark

beats.voice_sync_text: Bhakki capital gain Rajesh Section 54EC eligible NHAI bonds-il invest cheyyaan theerumaanichu. Sale date 10th August 2025 aanu. Rajesh 10th October 2025-il, athayathu within 2 months cheque payment 10 Lakh rupees complete cheythu. Ennaal NHAI bonds allot cheythathu 1st February 2026-il aanu. Evide Bombay High Court-inte Hindustan Unilever Limited ruling protect cheyyunnu. Assessee 6 months statutory period-naullil payment complete cheythaal, allotment delay aanaalum Section 54EC exemption deny cheyyaan paadilla. So Rajesh-inu 10 Lakh rupees Section 54EC exemption fully eligible aanu.

beats.voice_sync_text: Eethoru complex problem-il ninnu CA exam-il orkkenda moorthu golden rules: First, Section 50C-il Stamp Duty Value actual consideration-te 110 percent-inekaal kooduthalaayal SDV deemed full value aakum. Second, Section 54-il adjacent flats modify cheythu single habitable unit aakkiyaal Ananda Basappa precedent prakaaram exemption valid aanu. Third, Section 54EC-il payment date within 6 months aayal Hindustan Unilever precedent prakaaram bond allotment late aanaalum exemption claim cheyyaam. Brilliant work students!

rules.title: Section 50C 110% Safe Harbor Benchmark
rules.text: If Stamp Duty Value exceeds 110% of Actual Consideration, SDV becomes Deemed Full Value. Always compute 110% before applying Section 50C.

rules.title: Section 54 Adjacent Flats Unit Doctrine (CIT v. Ananda Basappa)
rules.text: Two adjacent flats modified into a single residential unit qualify as 'a residential house' even if acquired under separate sale deeds.

rules.title: Section 54EC Payment Date Landmark (Hindustan Unilever Ltd.)
rules.text: Payment made within 6 months of transfer satisfies Section 54EC timeline. Subsequent delay in bond allotment does not jeopardize exemption.

dt-c2-q32.context_pill: Section 54G | Shifting Industrial Undertaking from Urban to Non-Urban Area

beats.voice_sync_text: Makkale, ശ്രദ്ധichu kekkoo! Namukku Section 54G padikkam. Nammude case studyil, Apex Engineering Ltd enna company oru urban corporation limitil ulla industrial undertaking non-urban area-kku December 2025-il shift cheythu. Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27)-il avar pala assets transfer cheythu. Onnamathathu, Land transfer cheythu, sale proceeds ₹ 9 lakhs, cost of acquisition ₹ 4 lakhs, long-term capital asset aanu. Randamathathu, Building transfer cheythu, sale proceeds ₹ 17 lakhs, WDV under Section 50 ₹ 5 lakhs, depreciable asset aayathu kondu short-term capital gain aanu. Moonnamathathu, Plant & Machinery transfer cheythu, sale proceeds ₹ 15 lakhs, WDV under Section 50 ₹ 4 lakhs, short-term capital gain aanu. Naalaamathathu, Furniture transfer cheythu, sale proceeds ₹ 4 lakhs, WDV under Section 50 ₹ 2 lakhs. Athayath, ee four assets transfer cheythu, pakshe naye assets purchase cheythappol oru cheriya twist undu! Avar July 2026-il naye assets vaangiyavarku land-in ₹ 4 lakhs, building-in ₹ 6 lakhs, plant & machinery-in ₹ 15 lakhs, pinne furniture-in ₹ 2 lakhs invest cheythu. Ividuthe most important point enthannu vechaal, Section 54G-il furniture oru eligible capital asset alla! Let's classify them clearly!

title.text: Statutory Mandate & Conditions u/s 54G

quote.text: Where the capital gain arises from the transfer of a capital asset, being machinery or plant or land or building or any rights in building or land used for the purposes of an industrial undertaking... and the assessee has purchased new machinery or plant or acquired building or land within 1 year before or 3 years after the date of transfer, the capital gain shall be dealt with under section 54G.
quote.emphasis: within 1 year before or 3 years after the date of transfer

context_bubble.speaker: Section 54G
context_bubble.text: New assets must be purchased within 1 year before or 3 years after the transfer date. Furniture is strictly excluded from eligible assets.

beats.voice_sync_text: Aaduthathayittu, nalkiya new assets investment-inte total pool evide nokku. Land-il ₹ 4 lakhs, Building-il ₹ 6 lakhs, Plant & Machinery-il ₹ 15 lakhs vaangiya total qualifying investment ₹ 25 lakhs aane! Furniture-il vaangiya ₹ 2 lakhs ivide exclude cheyyanam. So total qualifying exemption pool is ₹ 25 lakhs!

Ee ₹ 25 lakhs exemption aadyam short-term capital gains-l adjust cheyyanam. Because short-term capital gain-inte tax incidence high aanu! Appol short-term capital gain completely nil aayi maarum. Pine baakki ulla exemption long-term capital gain-aaya land-inte ₹ 5 lakhs-il ninnu adjust cheythu baakki taxable long-term capital gain ₹ 2 lakhs aayi varum. Pinne furniture-inte ₹ 2 lakhs short-term capital gain fully taxable aanu!

title.text: Property Transfer: Stamp Duty Benchmark vs Actual Agreement

beats.voice_sync_text: Priypetta vidyarthikale, nammude case-ile assessee Mr. Vijay aanu. Vijay 1982-il oru residential house purchase cheythu, total cost ₹ 5,00,000. Ee property 1st April 2001-il Fair Market Value ₹ 15,00,000 aayirunnu, pakshe Stamp Duty Value ₹ 14,00,000 maathram. Ee asset-il randu thavana advance money forfeit cheythittundu: Onnamathathu June 2009-il ₹ 1,50,000, randamathathu July 2016-il ₹ 2,00,000. Pineed September 2015-il first floor construct cheythu for ₹ 5,08,000. Finally, Financial Year 2025-26-il property sale cheyyaan agreement vekkunnu for ₹ 40,00,000, with an advance of ₹ 2,00,000 received via account payee cheque on agreement date. Ennaal agreement date-ile Stamp Duty Value ₹ 52,00,000 aayirunnu! Ee multi-provision puzzle Section 50C, Section 51, matrum Section 112 vechu namukku solve cheyyaam.

cheque_advance.label: Advance ₹ 2,00,000 received via Account Payee Cheque

deemed_consideration.label: Section 50C Deemed Full Value of Consideration = ₹ 52,00,000

beats.voice_sync_text: Nammal aadyam Section 50C-yude agreement date proviso shradhikkannam. Rule ithaanu: Date of agreement-um date of registration-um different aanenkil, agreement date-ile Stamp Duty Value consider cheyyaam, provided advance money account payee cheque vazhiyo electronic clearing system vazhiyo on or before agreement date receive cheythirikkanam. Ivide ₹ 2,00,000 account payee cheque vazhi agreement date-il thanne kittiyathinaal, ₹ 52,00,000 aanu benchmark SDV. Ee SDV actual consideration-te 110 percentinekaal kooduthal aaya kond, Section 50C prakaram full value of consideration aayi ₹ 52,00,000 edukkanam.

title.text: Statutory Mandate: Section 50C Agreement Date Proviso

quote.text: Where the date of agreement fixing the consideration and the date of registration are not the same, the value adopted by the stamp valuation authority on the date of agreement may be taken, provided consideration or part thereof has been received by way of an account payee cheque or electronic clearing system on or before the date of agreement.
quote.citation: Proviso to Section 50C(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961
quote.emphasis: account payee cheque on or before the date of agreement

beats.voice_sync_text: Aduthathayi, Cost of Acquisition calculate cheyyaam. Section 55(2)(b) prakaram 1st April 2001-nu munpu vaangiya asset-nu Fair Market Value ₹ 15,00,000 and Stamp Duty Value ₹ 14,00,000 compare cheythu lower amount edukkuka, athayath ₹ 14,00,000. Actual cost ₹ 5,00,000 aayathinaal higher value aaya ₹ 14,00,000 COA aayi varum. Ini advance forfeiture: June 2009-il forfeit cheytha ₹ 1,50,000 1st April 2014-nu munpaayathinaal Section 51 prakaram COA-il ninnu deduct cheythu ₹ 12,50,000 aakkum. Ennaal July 2016-ile ₹ 2,00,000 Section 56(2)(ix) prakaram Income from Other Sources-il tax cheythathinaal ivide deduct cheyyilla!

Deemed Full Value ₹ 52,00,000-il ninnu brokerage @ 1% on actual price ₹ 40,000 kurachu Net Consideration ₹ 51,60,000 kittunnu. Indexation illathe LTCG ₹ 34,02,000 aanu. Pakshe Finance Act 2024-te amendment prakaram, resident individual-nu 23rd July 2024-nu munpu vaangiya property-il indexation koduthu tax calculate cheyyanulla option undu. Indexed COA ₹ 47,00,000 and Indexed COI ₹ 7,52,000 kurakkumbol ₹ 2,92,000 Long-Term Capital Loss varunnu! Loss vannathinaal indexation scheme-il tax Nil aanu. Assessee-kku beneficial aaya Nil tax liability select cheyyaam!

Randamathathu, Section 51 advance forfeiture cut-off date: 1st April 2014-nu munpulla forfeiture COA-il reduce cheyyumpol, athinu sheshamulla forfeiture Section 56(2)(ix) prakaram IFOS-il tax aakum. rules.heading: Section 50C Banking Channel Rule
rules.body: Agreement date Stamp Duty Value is valid only if advance consideration is received via account payee cheque/ECS on or before the agreement date.

rules.heading: Forfeited Advance Dual Mechanism
rules.body: Advance forfeited before 01-04-2014 reduces Cost of Acquisition u/s 51. Advance forfeited on or after 01-04-2014 is taxable under IFOS u/s 56(2)(ix).

rules.heading: Section 112 Beneficial Regime
rules.body: For properties acquired prior to 23-07-2024 by resident individuals, if indexation computation results in capital loss, the tax liability under Section 112 is effectively Nil.
